name: smoothdata_lowess
expr: yl = smoothdata(x,'lowess',5); yo = smoothdata(x,'loess',5); yl7 = smoothdata(x,'lowess',7);
comment: Sig: smoothdata(x,'lowess'|'loess',window). Local tricube-weighted regression: lowess = linear, loess = quadratic. For each sample the window is the F nearest points (shifted to stay in range), tricube weights of the in-window distance (window edges -> weight 0), fit + evaluate at the query point. Matches MATLAB exactly for an explicit window (auto default window is the same data-dependent-heuristic approximation as sgolay). Completes bugs/stats/smoothdata-methods. Verified vs MATLAB R2025b: lowess w5 = [1.7113 3.0349 4.5768 ...], loess w5 = [1.5509 2.9192 2 8 ...] (loess interior is the input unchanged -- a 3-point quadratic fit interpolates the centre).
